## Supplemental Figure 1E
```{r message = F, results = F, warning = F, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 6, supp_1E}
cancer_counts_filepath <- "/projects/home/tlchan/projects/ascites/second_data_freeze/clusterings/ascites_cancer_R3_300mg_20pm_multi_res/1.3/data/pseudobulk/ascites_cancer_R3_300mg_20pm_1_3_pseudobulk_counts.csv"
cancer_meta_filepath <- "/projects/home/tlchan/projects/ascites/second_data_freeze/clusterings/ascites_cancer_R3_300mg_20pm_multi_res/1.3/data/pseudobulk/ascites_cancer_R3_300mg_20pm_1_3_pseudobulk_meta.csv"

# Normalize counts
counts <- read_csv(cancer_counts_filepath) %>% column_to_rownames("featurekey")
norm_counts <- apply(counts, 2, function(c) {
    n_total <- sum(c)
    per_100k <- (c * 1000000) / n_total
    return(per_100k)
})
norm_counts <- log1p(norm_counts)

testing_csv <- "/projects/home/tlchan/projects/ascites/second_data_freeze/data/gene_programs/canon_gene_sets.csv"
testing_data <- read_csv(testing_csv, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    filter(grepl("NatureMed", program_name)) %>%
    select("program_name", "genes") %>%
    column_to_rownames("program_name")

# Get gene mapping
gastric_genes <- unlist(strsplit(testing_data["NatureMed_gastric", "genes"], split = ",")) %>%
    enframe() %>%
    rename(program_name = "name", gene = "value") %>%
    mutate(program_name = "gastric")
colon_genes <- unlist(strsplit(testing_data["NatureMed_colon", "genes"], split = ",")) %>%
    enframe() %>%
    rename(program_name = "name", gene = "value") %>%
    mutate(program_name = "colon")
gene_df <- rbind(gastric_genes, colon_genes)

# Make and scale heatmap matrix
heatmap_mtx <- norm_counts[gene_df$gene,]
heatmap_mtx <- t(scale(t(heatmap_mtx)))

heatmap_col_fun <- colorRamp2(c(min(heatmap_mtx), 0, max(heatmap_mtx)), c("purple", "black", "yellow"))

# This creates the dendrogram for the samples, using euclidean distance and Ward method. These can def be changed. see documentation
clustering_cols <- hclust(dist(t(heatmap_mtx), method = "euclidean"), method = "ward.D2")
col_hc <- as.dendrogram(clustering_cols)

# Make gene bar
genes <- rownames(heatmap_mtx)
programs <- paste(lapply(genes, function(gene) gene_df$program_name[match(gene, gene_df$gene)]), sep = " ", collapse = NULL)

gene_bar <- rowAnnotation(program = programs,
                          col = list(program = c('gastric' = '#fff2ac', 'colon' = '#fd9941')),
                          annotation_legend_param = list(title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 20),
                                                         labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 18)),
                          show_legend = TRUE,
                          show_annotation_name = FALSE)

# This creates the dendrogram for the genes
clustering_rows <- hclust(dist(heatmap_mtx, method = "euclidean"), method = "ward.D2")
row_hc <- as.dendrogram(clustering_rows)

hmap <- Heatmap(heatmap_mtx,
                name = "z-score",
                col = heatmap_col_fun,
                right_annotation = gene_bar,
                show_column_names = TRUE,
                column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 18),
                show_row_names = TRUE,
                row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 18),
                cluster_columns = col_hc,
                cluster_rows = row_hc,
                show_heatmap_legend = TRUE,
                heatmap_legend_param = list(direction = "horizontal",
                                            title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 20),
                                            labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 18)),
                column_title = "Patient",
                column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 20),
                row_title = "Genes",
                row_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 20))

# pdf("/projects/home/tlchan/fig_panels/supp_1e.pdf", width = 14, height = 12)
draw(hmap, heatmap_legend_side = "bottom")
# dev.off()
```

## Supplemental Figure 1H
